comments.content: The declarations in the header are static and take an `App::DocumentObject* owner` parameter, but the definitions in DrawViewPart.cpp are non-static member functions taking only `std::string element`. This mismatch will cause a compile/link error. Either make the definitions static and cast `owner` to `DrawViewPart*` (as the old DrawUtil implementations did), or declare them as non-static member functions without the `owner` parameter.
